error_message:
ERROR MESSAGE:
"[SCTP]   Received SCTP SHUTDOWN EVENT"

Context:
This SCTP shutdown event indicates that the SCTP association (assoc_id 337) between the CU and DU was terminated unexpectedly. Following this, the log shows:
- "[F1AP]   Received SCTP state 1 for assoc_id 337, removing endpoint"
- "[NR_RRC]   releasing DU ID 3584 (gNB-Eurecom-DU) on assoc_id 337"

This error is critical as it represents loss of SCTP connectivity between the Central Unit (CU) and Distributed Unit (DU), which would prevent further signaling and data exchange, effectively disrupting the 5G system operation. No stack trace or crash info is present, but the SCTP shutdown event itself is a fatal connectivity failure.
